root_cause: the exact 2013-04-10 XDXR event occurred inside a full-day suspension interval; the first subsequent positive raw bar is 2013-05-16, so same-day market-row lookup is structurally invalid
resolution: use the first market row on or after the event solely to obtain its carried previous_tradable_close, while applying the unchanged XDXR step to all rows with date greater than or equal to the event date
